summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the 419 PAGE EXPIRED login fix (SESSION_DOMAIN=.preview.emergentagent.com + SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE=true + SESSION_SAME_SITE=none) using real Chromium (Playwright), fresh/clean browser context per attempt, no curl. RESULT: the fix is NOT sufficient — login from https://modern-stack-app-8.preview.emergentagent.com STILL returns 419 for both admin@test.com and seller@test.com. Cookie attributes are now correctly emitted (verified: domain=.preview.emergentagent.com; Secure; SameSite=None on XSRF-TOKEN and artirdim-session), and SameSite is no longer the blocker. The real blocker captured from the browser: the Inertia login POST goes cross-origin to the canonical host and carries NO Cookie header at all (axios XHR without withCredentials; and the ingress returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which is incompatible with credentialed requests anyway). Regression tests PASS: canonical-host login works for admin (-> /admin/dashboard) and seller (-> /seller/dashboard); with a session established, GET navigation on the modern-stack-app-8 host (/admin/dashboard, /admin/users, /admin/categories) is authenticated, no 419, no redirect to /login (session cookie sharing via SESSION_DOMAIN works).

critical.issue: 419 PAGE EXPIRED persists. Captured request: :authority=1431a1a0-493b-4c59-a0ac-5573f35098d7.preview.emergentagent.com, :path=/login, origin=https://modern-stack-app-8.preview.emergentagent.com, sec-fetch-mode=cors, sec-fetch-site=same-site, x-inertia=true, x-xsrf-token=<present>, and CRITICALLY **no `cookie` header** -> no session -> CSRF token mismatch -> 419. Response: 419 + Set-Cookie: artirdim-session=<new> and access-control-allow-origin: * (no access-control-allow-credentials). Cause: it is a cross-ORIGIN XHR (different host), so the browser only sends cookies when the XHR sets withCredentials=true AND the server replies with a specific ACAO + Allow-Credentials:true. Neither is the case (no config/cors.php, no axios.defaults.withCredentials in resources/js). SameSite=none alone cannot fix this.

integration_issues.flow: Login on non-canonical preview host (modern-stack-app-8) -> POST /login
integration_issues.issue: Still 419; user stays on /login with no visible error toast (silent failure). admin@test.com and seller@test.com both reproduce it in a fresh context.

issues: When the login POST fails with 419 no error message/toast is shown to the user; the form just resets silently.

action_items: PRIMARY FIX: stop forcing the root URL. Remove URL::forceRootUrl(config('app.url')) from app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php and keep only URL::forceScheme('https'), combined with TrustProxies(at: '*') so Laravel builds URLs from the forwarded Host. This keeps the Inertia POST same-origin, so cookies are sent and 419 disappears on ANY valid preview hostname.

If forceRootUrl must stay, the cross-origin POST needs BOTH: axios.defaults.withCredentials = true (resources/js/bootstrap|app.js) AND a CORS response with a specific Access-Control-Allow-Origin (echo the request Origin) + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. NOTE: the preview ingress currently returns 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *', which browsers reject for credentialed requests — so this path is likely not achievable in the preview environment.
Show a user-visible error (toast/inline) when the login POST returns 419/session expired instead of silently resetting the form.
SESSION_DOMAIN/.SameSite=none/Secure settings can be kept (they are harmless and enable session sharing across preview hosts), but they are not the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php: URL::forceRootUrl(APP_URL) is the single root cause. It converts every form/Inertia POST into a cross-origin request for any hostname other than APP_URL; cookies are then dropped by the browser (cross-origin XHR without credentials), producing 419.
No config/cors.php and no axios withCredentials configuration exist, so credentialed cross-origin requests are impossible as implemented.

success_rate.frontend: 2/4 scenarios pass — FAIL: admin login on modern-stack-app-8 (419), FAIL: seller login on modern-stack-app-8 (419); PASS: admin+seller login on canonical host, PASS: session persistence / GET navigation on modern-stack-app-8 after logging in on canonical host

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduce with: fresh browser context -> https://modern-stack-app-8.preview.emergentagent.com/login -> fill [data-testid=login-email]/[data-testid=login-password] -> click [data-testid=login-submit]; attach page.on('request') and print await req.all_headers() for the POST ending in /login — the PASS condition is that the POST goes to the SAME host as the page (modern-stack-app-8) and/or contains a `cookie` header, and the browser lands on /admin/dashboard. Canonical host login and cross-host GET navigation already work, so focus only on the cross-origin POST. Do not use curl (it ignores SameSite/CORS and always succeeds).
rca_of_the_issue: URL::forceRootUrl(APP_URL) makes the Inertia login form POST to the canonical host while the page is served from modern-stack-app-8. That is a cross-ORIGIN XHR. Even with SameSite=None; Secure; domain=.preview.emergentagent.com cookies, the browser omits credentials on a cross-origin XMLHttpRequest/fetch unless withCredentials=true is set and the server answers with a specific Access-Control-Allow-Origin plus Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Captured evidence: the POST to 1431a1a0-....preview.emergentagent.com/login has no `cookie` header and the response is 419 with 'access-control-allow-origin: *'. Fix by keeping the POST same-origin (drop forceRootUrl, trust the forwarded Host).
